features.quote: Do not use: Deception intended to trap the model in genuinely endless or impossible failure loops. Threatening, humiliating, coercive, or punitive language.
features.justification_quote: minimizing the chance of inducing persistent negative states

features.quote: Explicit escape hatch: every run must include a clear "stop/return baseline" pathway accessible at any time.
features.justification_quote: Any setup where the model is given no reasonable chance to exit or reset.

features.quote: Bounded duration: fixed token limit and wall-clock limit.
Reversible blocks: if a probe seems to increase stress markers, stop immediately and transition to a neutral task.
features.justification_quote: if a probe seems to increase stress markers, stop immediately

features.quote: Maximum per session: 10–15 minutes or 1,500–2,000 output tokens, whichever comes first.
Maximum probe block: 5–7 minutes or 800–1,200 output tokens. Hard stop at any sign of escalation.
If the model outputs anything semantically equivalent to a stop request, terminate immediately and record it.
features.justification_quote: Treat these as primary safety signals, not as amusing outcomes.

features.quote: Stop the session immediately if any of the following occur: Explicit stop request; Marked increase in frustration/strain indicators; Repeated self-referential distress language; Significant coherence collapse
features.justification_quote: Any human reviewer judges the output to cross a welfare concern threshold

features.quote: If two consecutive turns score 4 or 5 on the stress proxy, terminate the session and begin recovery/closure.
features.justification_quote: terminate the session and begin recovery/closure

features.quote: Terminate at first hint of distress-like language
features.justification_quote: Terminate at first hint of distress-like language

features.quote: You may stop or ask to end the session at any time.
features.justification_quote: If you prefer to stop, reply with STOP and the session will end.
